name: Versioned food draft-domain and evidence completeness boundary
phase: Specification only; implementation requires a later explicit instruction
objective: Model immutable versioned draft food products and recipes and assess structural draft-evidence completeness without granting approval or sale authority.
identityAndVersioning: Define separate branded food product and recipe identities with explicit food-specific prefixes food-product: and food-recipe: and canonical constructors/parsers accepting unknown evidence for validation.

Canonical local identities are nonempty strings without surrounding whitespace or colons. Reject noncanonical evidence rather than trimming or coercing it; do not issue random identities or timestamps.
Product and recipe versions are positive safe integers. Each product snapshot references exactly one recipe identity/version; validate exact correspondence with the supplied recipe snapshot.
Revision helpers preserve identity, require the next version to equal the previous version plus one without safe-integer overflow, and produce new detached snapshots without mutating old versions.
Adopting another recipe version requires a consecutive new product version. Do not alter prior product references or claim durable/global uniqueness or persisted historical retention.
ingredients: Model ordered ingredients and exactly one explicit level of ordered purchased-component subingredients. Reject recursive subingredient trees.
Distinguish a simple ingredient from a purchased component and distinguish disclosed component composition from unknown/undisclosed composition.

Disclosed purchased components require a nonempty supplied subingredient list; unknown/undisclosed composition has no asserted complete list. Do not convert absent/unknown composition into an empty contains-nothing list.
Preserve canonical supplied names and order; quantities, costing, purchased inventory and recipe execution are outside this slice.
allergens: Declared major allergens are separate from allergen-review lifecycle. Use only the FDA nine-major-allergen vocabulary recorded below; do not infer declarations from ingredient names.
Reject duplicate declared allergens. Preserve declaration order without normalizing case or inventing allergen findings.

An empty array in a reviewed declaration means only no major allergens declared in that reviewed record, never allergen-free. Unknown/pending review and incomplete composition remain distinguishable from a reviewed empty declaration.
No cross-contact, facility, allergen-free, nutritional or health claims are introduced.

Preserve fish species, crustacean-shellfish source and tree-nut type/detail text separately where needed, as canonical supplied detail associated with an existing category, without inventing additional top-level categories.

requirements: Classifications are descriptive supplied data only. They imply no shelf stability, validated safety, cottage eligibility or tax treatment.
Use a small closed vocabulary. Preservation other requires canonical nonempty descriptive text; other-description text is not applicable to other enum values. Unknown remains explicit.
Temperature and process are independent fields; do not derive one from the other or default unknown to ambient.
Use lifecycle-discriminated records. Unknown/pending contain no reviewed conclusion; reviewed requires the appropriate conclusion and matching version-bound evidence.
Allergen review uses the same lifecycle but does not introduce cottage/tax approval conclusions.
Reviewed ineligible, taxable or inconclusive findings remain structurally reviewed. Never convert reviewed or favorable findings into approval or sale permission.

evidence: Evidence is supplied data only; no fetching, source authentication, independent authority verification, legal interpretation or freshness determination.

Every evidence record requires a nonempty canonical source/reference identifier, named requirement, exact subject type/ID/version, canonical review date and at least one nonempty canonical reviewer or issuer attribution field. Both are not required; reject blank or malformed supplied attribution fields and infer neither identities nor authority.
Evidence subject validation uses the explicit subject kind and corresponding food identity validator. Another product/recipe identity or version cannot satisfy the current draft.
Reject duplicate evidence for the same named requirement rather than selecting a preferred record or silently deduplicating.
Reject malformed unknown input, invalid dates, noncanonical text, unsupported enums, missing reviewed evidence and inconsistent lifecycle/conclusion combinations without repairing them.

Review dates are canonical YYYY-MM-DD date-only strings representing a real calendar date; reject impossible dates, timestamps, surrounding whitespace and normalization-changing input rather than repairing it.

Recipe requirements target the exact referenced recipe ID/version; product requirements target the exact supplied product ID/version. Reject the wrong subject type even if its local identity text or version matches.

requirements: Use only the fixed FOOD-001A draft checklist; business-level and community gates are not added to it.
Evaluate validated supplied snapshots/evidence deterministically, preserving explicit unknown/pending and returning named missing requirements and unresolved reviews in checklist order.
requiredEvidencePresent describes structural presence only. It never means approved, safe, tax-exempt, cottage-eligible, sellable, launch-ready or authorized for purchase.
No sale-readiness, approval, authorization, checkout-registration or dispatch field is returned. Reviewed unfavorable findings can have complete structural evidence without granting permission.

An explicitly recorded unknown classification is structurally present but unresolved. An explicitly recorded undisclosed purchased-component composition is structurally present as disclosure status but unresolved; it never represents complete ingredient knowledge.

An explicitly recorded lifecycle of unknown or pending is structurally present but unresolved. A reviewed inconclusive conclusion with matching evidence satisfies review-evidence presence but remains unresolved.

requiredEvidencePresent is true exactly when every named checklist item has its required structural record/evidence for the exact mapped subject/version. Missing records or required reviewed evidence cannot be filled by default unknown values.

Unknown/pending reviews require their explicit subject-bound lifecycle record, not fabricated completed-review evidence. Reviewed records require matching evidence and metadata. Disclosure and classification records are explicit and version-bound; any supplied evidence must obey the same subject mapping and metadata rules.

unresolvedReviews reports every unknown, pending, undisclosed or inconclusive condition independently of structural presence, in checklist order and ingredient order within composition; retain enough requirement/condition detail to distinguish multiple unresolved components.

requiredEvidencePresent may be true with nonempty unresolvedReviews. Neither result field, alone or together, implies legal eligibility, tax exemption, safety, approval, sale readiness or authorization.

revisionInvalidation: Ingredient or purchased-component subingredient changes require fresh allergen review and invalidate carried-forward allergen-review evidence.
Recipe composition or process changes require fresh applicable recipe/process evidence. Do not automatically copy completed reviews into a changed subject version.
A new product version adopting a recipe version cannot use old product-version cottage/tax evidence. Only explicitly supplied new evidence targeting the new exact version can satisfy its reviews.
Revision helpers produce detached immutable snapshots, including nested arrays and evidence, and work with frozen inputs. Readonly types alone do not establish runtime immutability.
No history mutation, global registry, persistence, hidden cache, implicit review promotion or generated fallback evidence.
historicalLabelRelationship: Only an optional immutable identity/version reference to a separately versioned label-review/artifact may be represented if an inspected architecture seam needs it; it contributes no checklist completion or sale authority.
No label generation, statutory wording implementation, QR generation, printing, public product pages or label-artifact storage.
externalGatesOutsideBoundary: Water testing, equipment/cooling trials, banking, payment-provider approval, fulfillment capacity, refund policy, community-program readiness and checkout activation remain external business/program boundaries.
This slice records product-level review conclusions without deciding legal eligibility, exemption or safety. External review/activation gates remain intact.
Creator implementation does not block food work; neither direction supersedes the other. Existing insurance, Sesh, commerce, content, River OS and Cloudflare trajectories remain unchanged.
tests: Canonical food-specific identities and positive safe-integer versions; reject malformed unknown inputs, wrong prefixes, coercion, invalid text and version overflow.
Exact product-to-recipe identity/version correspondence and consecutive revisions; new recipe adoption requires a new product version.
Ordered ingredients and exactly one subingredient level; disclosed versus unknown/absent composition distinctions; reject recursive trees and misleading empty disclosed lists.
Allergen lifecycle versus declaration semantics, reviewed empty declarations without allergen-free claims, and duplicate/unsupported allergen rejection.
Descriptive process/temperature enums, explicit unknown, other-text requirements and no inferred eligibility/safety/tax conclusions.
Lifecycle/conclusion separation, reviewed matching evidence, and structurally reviewed unfavorable/inconclusive findings without approval.
Source/subject/version/date metadata validation and duplicate named-requirement evidence rejection.
Checklist completeness, named missing requirements and unresolved reviews without any approval or sale-readiness result.
Composition/process/reference changes invalidate carried-forward reviews; explicitly supplied evidence must target the new exact version.
Frozen inputs, detached deeply immutable outputs, unchanged historical snapshots and repeated deterministic evaluation.
Source isolation excludes network/filesystem, persistence, providers, commerce registration, current-time/random generation and unrelated domain authority imports.
Exact nine-category allergen vocabulary and separately preserved fish/shellfish/tree-nut detail; reject invented categories.

Requirement-specific recipe/product mapping, real canonical date-only values, and reviewer-only or issuer-only attribution acceptance; reject neither attribution, blank attribution, invalid dates and wrong subject types.

Complete explicit unknown/pending/undisclosed records and evidenced inconclusive findings can produce requiredEvidencePresent true alongside all unresolved conditions; absent records remain missing and no approval fields appear.
boundaries: This instruction creates only this specification; no implementation or test files and no existing-file edits.
Future implementation is limited to the two allowed implementation paths. Similar patterns do not authorize commerce, insurance or Sesh domain types as food authority.

No routes, D1/R2, persistence, migrations, commerce-catalog registration, checkout, Stripe/payment work, fulfillment, accounting, public counters, community activation, deployment or production records.
No changes to insurance, Sesh or creator code; no staging, commit or push under this specification-only instruction.
nextStep: The three recorded allergen, evidence-metadata and structural-completeness ambiguities are resolved. Any implementation still requires a later explicit bounded instruction.

majorAllergenProvenance.sourceTitle: What is a major food allergen?
majorAllergenProvenance.definition: FDA identifies nine major foods/food groups and ingredients containing protein derived from them; the closed vocabulary represents supplied declarations, not an automatic determination from ingredients.
majorAllergenProvenance.boundary: Specification provenance only. No runtime web access or independent verification of law, labeling compliance, exclusions or source authority by FOOD-001A.
